title: Control Tower and SCP strategy
scenario: Kestrel Mutual, an insurer, runs 45 member accounts (plus a separate management account) across claims, underwriting and sandbox teams, and each account's local administrators hold full rights. In the last audit an administrator switched off audit logging in one account, and a sandbox team launched workloads in a Region that the regulator does not permit. The regulator allows only two named Regions, and the compliance officer wants that rule and a single audit record to hold even against an account's root user, including for accounts opened next year. New business units expect an account with the baseline already in place within one working day, and the platform team has three people.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
The compliance officer requires one tamper-resistant audit record that no account administrator can stop, delete or change
The platform team of three cannot hand-build or hand-configure each new account
Restrictions must not depend on editing policies account by account
requiredArtifact: Architecture decision record + diagram notes + cost assumptions

rubric.label: Why live lab was unsuitable documented
Region restriction and audit record cover all 45 member accounts, their root users, and accounts added later without per-account work
A new account with the baseline in place within one working day is achievable by a three-person team

constraint_reason: Service unavailable or not disposable in a personal same-day lab
